title: Quartz Dish For Essential Oil Kit
description:
Quartz is widely known for producing the cleanest vapour possible. These Quartz Dishes from 7th floor are designed to be used with a Da Buddha, Silver Surfer or Super Surfer Vaporizer essential oil kit.
The quartz dishes come in 2 different styles. The Silver Surfer and Super Surfer use a cone shaped dish while the Da Buddha dish has vertical sides.
Included
1 x Quartz Dish
